content:
Sonos' flagship soundbar drops to its lowest price ever for Black Friday. Starting today you can score a brand new Sonos Arc Ultra Dolby Atmos soundbar for just $849 with free shipping after a $250 off instant discount. At this price, getting it brand new is even cheaper than getting it refurbished. It features true Dolby Atmos support and a built-in Sound Motion woofer that pumps out impressive bass even without a discrete sub.

Save $250 Off the Sonos Arc Ultra Soundbar

Given the number of upgrades, the Sonos Arc Ultra should be considered more as a new class of flagship soundbar than a mere update of the original Arc. At first glance, both look similar, with the same 46" long profile, but the internals are totally different. Whereas the Arc featured a 5.0.2ch setup with eleven speakers and no sub, the Arc Ultra boasts an expanded 9.4.1ch setup with fourteen speakers including a four-motor, dual-membrane Sound Motion woofer for better bass response and low end. This is a pretty significant upgrade alone if you don't plan on adding a discrete subwoofer.

The Arc Ultra also supports Dolby Atmos thanks to two dedicated up-firing tweeters for spatial audio and new AI enhancement technology to isolate and boost the clarity of dialogue and voices. It has a built-in microphone so that it can be controlled using voice commands using your favorite smart assistant. Check out our own Sonos Arc Ultra review.

The Sonos Sub (Gen 4) subwoofer is also on sale

The audio savvy knows that a single speaker isn't enough to reproduce an entire soundstage. If you could pick only one other speaker, then a subwoofer would make the most meaningful impact. The Sonos Sub 4 has hit a new price low during the recertified sale. It's currently priced at $719, a savings of 20%. The Sub 4 features dual inward-facing 5"x8" woofers and a traditional ported design that allows for a louder and deeper low-end. It also has much more power than the Sub Mini and can reverberate the walls of any sized room in your house.

New for 2026: Sonos Beam Ultra Soundbar

The Sonos Beam Ultra is more than just an incremental upgrade over its Gen 2 predecessor. Like the Arc Ultra compared to the Arc, this is practically an entirely different soundbar. Although the size profile isn't much different (29 inches long vs 25 inches), the Beam Ultra now houses a total of nine total speakers instead of five. This improves the Beam's surround sound capabilities two-fold: (1) it is now technically a 7.1.2ch system instead of 5.1.2ch and (2) it has two physical upfiring speakers for true Dolby Atmos support whereas the previous Beam Gen 2 used virtual height channels for a simulated Atmos experience. Other upgrades include AI speech enhanced to isolate and amplify dialogue, Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.3, and USB-C line-in. It also has a microphone for voice control.

New for 2026: Sonos Ace Ultra Headphones

The Sonos Ace Ultra has also undergone major renovation, which isn't as surprising since the original Ace was Sonos' first foray into the world of over-ear headphones. The Ace Ultra is better sounding than ever before thanks to a combination of second generation custom engineered 40mm drivers and adaptive EQ that tunes the sound in real time based on how the headphones fit. Noise cancelation has also improved up to 2X with the presence of ten microphones instead of eight.

An interesting feature unique to the Sonos Ace Ultra is the replaceable battery. All lithium batteries lose maximum charge over time. And most of the time, the only solution is to replace the headphones. Sonos, however, allows you to buy a replacement battery kit that you can install yourself. It's not hard, Sonos provides instructions, and it doesn't void your warranty. although it's not completely toolless.
